root.Title: SpeedScan Manager Help
root.Summary: Scan documents at the push of a button and then decide where they should go – into a folder, by email, to the printer or into an Office document.

getting-started.Title: Getting started
getting-started.Summary: What the program can do, where to find it and how to connect your scanner.

overview.Title: What is SpeedScan Manager?
overview.Summary: SpeedScan Manager controls your TWAIN scanner and handles the work after the scan for you.
overview.Html:
The program runs unobtrusively in the notification area of the taskbar. You load a document, press the scan button – and then choose what should happen with the scan.

What you can do with it

Save to folderStore as PDF, JPEG or PNG in a folder of your choice.
Send by emailYour email program opens with the scan as an attachment.
PrintPrint the pages directly on a printer (copier replacement).
Word, Excel, PowerPointInsert the pages as images into a new Office document.
Picture folderSave the pages as JPEG images in Pictures\SpeedScanManager.
Open with PDF programOpen the scan in the program that Windows has set up for the file.
Custom programsStart up to ten custom programs with the scan.

The program does this automatically

  • Text recognition (OCR) – makes PDFs searchable.
  • Remove blank pages, straighten skewed pages and rotate pages correctly.
  • Detect color – each page is saved as color, grayscale or black and white.
  • Carrier sheet – combine two halves of a folded A3 sheet into one image.
Tip

The fastest way to start is with the Quick Menu: it is already turned on and asks after each scan where the scan should go.

starting.Title: Tray icon and menu
starting.Summary: SpeedScan Manager has no large main window – you reach everything through the icon in the taskbar.
starting.Html:
After starting, the program icon appears in the notification area of the taskbar (bottom right, possibly behind the arrow ˄). Click it to open the menu.

The tray menu. At the top you can see whether the scanner is ready.

The icon shows the status

  NormalThe scanner is connected and ready.
  With orange dotA scan is running or is currently being processed.
  Faded with red lineNo scanner connected or the scanner is turned off.

Hover the mouse over the icon to see the scanner name – during a scan also the number of pages scanned so far.

Clicking

Left click or right clickOpens the menu.
Double-clickOpens the Settings.

The commands in the menu

ScanStarts a scan with the current settings. Not available while the scanner is disconnected or a scan is running.
Cancel scanOnly visible while a scan is running.
OpenOpens the Settings window.
Select scanner...Choose the scanner if several are connected (more).
Set up scan button...Sets up the button on the scanner (again) (more).
Profile management...Rename, delete and sort profiles.
Show scan resultShows the most recently saved file in Explorer (only after a scan).
HelpThis help and the version information.
ExitCloses the program. If a scan is running, you are asked first; if it is being saved at that moment, the program closes only afterwards.

Start with Windows

The switch Start with Windows on the General page of the settings determines whether the program starts automatically. After a new installation it is turned on; after an update from version 0.1.x it stays off until you turn it on.

Note

The program only runs once at a time. If you start it a second time, the settings open instead. Settings and profiles are stored in the folder %AppData%\SpeedScanManager.

scanner-connection.Title: Connect scanner
scanner-connection.Summary: USB and network scanners are detected automatically as soon as they are turned on.
scanner-connection.Html:
1. Install the TWAIN driver of the scanner (from the manufacturer).
  2. Turn on the scanner and connect it to the PC via USB or network.
  3. Wait a moment: the tray icon changes from to , and the name of the scanner with a green dot appears at the top of the menu.

What happens in the background

When a device is connected or disconnected, the program checks the scanner immediately. After the program starts, it queries the scanner for the first time after a few seconds. If the scanner is disconnected, the balloon tip “The scanner is not connected or is turned off.” appears once.

Tip

If possible, connect only one scanner. If several are connected, use Select scanner to decide which one is used.

Warning

If the scanner is not detected, check the cable or network, whether it is turned on, and whether the TWAIN driver is installed. More help: Common problems.

scanner-selection.Title: Select scanner
scanner-selection.Summary: Specify which scanner is used if several are connected.
scanner-selection.Html:
1. Click the tray icon and choose Select scanner... (not during a scan).
  2. Select the scanner in the list. (USB) or (Network) shows the connection; USB scanners are at the top.
  3. Click OK. The selection also applies after a restart.
The “Select scanner” window

The first entry (Automatic) leaves the choice to the program. Cancel or the close icon closes the window without changes.

Note

The list updates automatically when a scanner is added. If none is found, the list shows “No scanner found” – you can still confirm (Automatic). If the selected scanner cannot be reached, the tray icon shows “Selection: ... (offline)”.

sysreq.Title: System requirements
sysreq.Summary: What your PC and your scanner must provide.
sysreq.Html:
Operating systemWindows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit).
ScannerTWAIN-compatible scanner (USB or network) with the TWAIN driver installed. Since SpeedScan Manager is a 32-bit program, the driver must provide a 32-bit TWAIN source.
.NETThe installation package does not require a separate .NET installation.
Scan to E-MailAn email program with MAPI support (e.g. Outlook).
Scan to PrintAn installed printer.
Word, Excel, PowerPointTo open the created files – they are also created without Office.
Note

The setup installs text recognition for the language chosen in the setup and for English, as well as the data for automatic image rotation. The program downloads further languages when needed (internet connection required): see the “File type” page.

scanning.Title: Scanning
scanning.Summary: Scan documents, use the scan button, scan long pages and use the carrier sheet.

scan-quick.Title: How to scan a document
scan-quick.Summary: With the Quick Menu (default setting) you scan first and then decide where the scan should go.
scan-quick.Html:
1. Load the pages into the scanner.
  2. Press the scan button on the scanner – or click the tray icon and select Scan.
  3. Wait until all pages have been fed in. The scan is processed and saved in the save folder.
  4. The Quick Menu appears. Click the desired destination and then Save – or simply double-click the destination.
The Quick Menu after the scan
1The destinations: folder, email, printer, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, picture folder and PDF program. The arrow keys move the selection.
2Cancel: The Quick Menu closes; the file that has already been saved is kept.
3Save: Carries out the selected destination.
Tip

If you select Save to folder, you can still change the file name and folder in the next window.

Choose quality quickly

On the General page of the Settings, you set with one click how finely the scan is made:

TileImage qualityCompressionSuitable for
RecommendedAutomatic3most documents
Small fileNormal5email sending, archive
High image qualityFine1photos, fine details
Customown valuesown valuesopens the “Scan mode” page
Note

As long as the Quick Menu is turned on, the Application page in the settings is grayed out – you choose the destination after the scan anyway.

scan-button.Title: Scan button on the scanner
scan-button.Summary: Pressing the button on the scanner starts a scan – even if SpeedScan Manager is not running yet.
scan-button.Html:
Set up once

So that Windows passes the button on to SpeedScan Manager, it must be set up once. This happens automatically at the first start:

  1. Windows asks for administrator rights (User Account Control). Click Yes.
  2. Done – from now on the button starts a scan. Administrator rights are no longer required afterwards.
Tip

Did you decline the prompt or connect another scanner? Select Set up scan button... in the tray menu – the setup starts again, and afterwards a balloon tip “The scan button is set up.” appears. For a newly connected scanner, the prompt also appears automatically at the next program start.

How it works

  • SpeedScan Manager registers itself in Windows as the program for the scan button and thereby replaces the Windows default program. When uninstalling, the original state is restored.
  • If the program is already running, it scans immediately. If it is not yet running, Windows starts it and the scan begins as soon as it is ready.
Note

While a scan is running – also as long as a window such as the Quick Menu is still open afterwards – the button is ignored. Two presses within about 1.5 seconds count as one. If the program cannot use the scanner (e.g. TWAIN not ready), the button does not respond.

If you decline the prompt, it is not shown again. You can then still scan via the tray menu.

scan-no-quick.Title: Scanning without the Quick Menu
scan-no-quick.Summary: Always the same destination? Then turn off the Quick Menu and set the destination in advance – optionally as a profile.
scan-no-quick.Html:
1. Open the Settings (double-click the tray icon).
  2. On the General page, turn off the switch Use Quick Menu.
  3. Select a profile under Active profile – or set the destination yourself on the Application page.
  4. Click OK.
  5. Scan as usual with the scan button or via Scan in the tray menu.

What happens after the scan

Scan to FolderThe Save to folder window appears.
All other destinationsAre carried out immediately. If the Rename file after scan switch on the Save page is on, the “Save to folder” window appears beforehand.

scan-display.Title: What happens after the scan
scan-display.Summary: Every scan is first saved as a file – only then is the chosen destination carried out.
scan-display.Html:
1. The pages are processed

Depending on the settings, in this order:

  1. Carrier sheet: front and back sides are joined side by side.
  2. Crop to the sheet (only with paper size “Automatic detection”, without carrier sheet).
  3. Remove blank pages. If all pages are blank, nothing is saved and a message appears.
  4. Correct skew (if turned on).
  5. Automatic image rotation (if turned on).
  6. Color detection with color mode “Automatic color detection”: color, gray or black and white per page.
  7. Text recognition and saving as PDF, JPEG or PNG.

2. The file is saved

In the save folder (default setting Documents\SpeedScanManager). Existing files are never overwritten. If the folder is not writable, the scan ends up in Documents\SpeedScanManager and you receive a message.

3. The destination is carried out

Save to folderOpens the Save to folder window for file name and folder.
Send by emailOpens your email program (MAPI) with the file as an attachment.
PrintPrints the pages at original size.
To Word / Excel / PowerPointCreates an Office document with the pages as images, saves it next to the scan and opens it.
To picture folderSaves the pages as JPEG in Pictures\SpeedScanManager and shows the first image in Explorer.
Edit with PDF EditOpens the file(s) with the program that Windows has set up for this.
Custom applicationStarts your program with the saved files (only without the Quick Menu).
Tip

File not found? Select Show scan result in the tray menu – Explorer shows the most recently saved file.

scan-continue.Title: Cancel / continue scan
scan-continue.Summary: Stop a running scan – or combine several batches into one document.
scan-continue.Html:
Cancel scan

Click the tray icon and select Cancel scan. The pages scanned up to that point are discarded, and a balloon tip reports “Scan canceled”. This also works while the multifeed question or “Scan more documents?” is displayed.

Note

If you select Exit during a scan, the program asks first. If the scan is being saved at that moment, the program only exits afterwards. Scans that have already been saved are never deleted when exiting (also not when signing out of Windows).

Combine several batches into one scan

  1. On the Scan mode page, turn on the switch Continue scanning after the current scan.
  2. Scan the first batch.
  3. The question “Scan more documents?” appears with the page count so far. Load the next batch and click Continue.
  4. When all pages are scanned, click Finish scan. All pages are saved together.
The question after each pass
Note

If a multifeed is discarded with Retry in one pass, the earlier passes are kept.

scan-long.Title: Scanning long pages
scan-long.Summary: Scan receipts and other long documents using the automatic paper size.
scan-long.Html:
1. On the Paper page, set the paper size to Automatic detection.
  2. Do not set the multifeed detection to a variant with length (so set it to Off or Ultrasonic).
  3. Scan as usual.

In this mode the program allows pages up to 8.5 × 125 inches (approx. 21.6 × 317 cm). For scanners from Fujitsu, PFU and Ricoh (PaperStream IP), it additionally sets the manufacturer-specific settings for long pages. Whether the image is cropped to the actual length is decided by the scanner driver.

Warning

Pages over 86 cm are only possible up to 200 dpi (image quality Automatic or Fine); at higher resolution, 86 cm is the limit. The older driver “FUJITSU fi-…” only manages 35.6 cm; if both are installed, the program uses PaperStream IP. The maximum length depends on the scanner model. Long pages result in larger files.

scan-carrier.Title: Scanning with a carrier sheet
scan-carrier.Summary: With a carrier sheet you scan documents that are larger than A4 (e.g. A3) – folded, in one pass.
scan-carrier.Html:
1. On the Paper page, open the Carrier sheet settings..., turn on carrier sheet mode and select the output size.
  2. Fold the document in the middle and place it in the carrier sheet.
  3. Feed the carrier sheet into the scanner and scan two-sided (duplex).
  4. Front and back sides are joined side by side into one image.
Warning

Only scanners built for a carrier sheet will feed it in. Joining only happens with duplex scans – with a one-sided scan, each page is brought to the output size individually.

settings-group.Title: Settings
settings-group.Summary: The settings window and all its pages, explained step by step.

settings.Title: The settings window
settings.Summary: Here you define how scanning and saving are done. You open it by double-clicking the tray icon.
settings.Html:
The settings window with the “General” page
1Sidebar: choose the page here. If the Quick Menu is on, “Application” is grayed out.
2The selected page with its settings in groups. Longer pages can be scrolled.
3Help: opens the help for exactly this page.
4OK applies and closes, Apply applies without closing, Cancel discards.

Changes only take effect after OK or Apply. As long as something is not applied, “Unapplied changes” is shown at the bottom left. Cancel, Esc and the close icon discard these changes.

The pages

GeneralQuick Menu, autostart, scan quality, profile and theme (see below).
ApplicationWhat happens after the scan (only without the Quick Menu).
SaveSave folder and file name.
Scan modeResolution, color, one- or two-sided.
File typePDF, JPEG or PNG, text recognition.
PaperPaper size, carrier sheet, multifeed.
File sizeCompression for smaller files.

The “General” page

“General” page
Use Quick MenuOn: after each scan you choose the destination (more). Then the “Application” page and the “Profile” group are grayed out.
Start with WindowsStarts the program with Windows (default setting: on).
Scan qualityRecommended, Small file and High image quality set image quality and compression. The matching tile shows a check mark. Custom is marked if your values match no tile – one click opens the “Scan mode” page. Can also be operated with Tab and Space.
ProfileOnly without the Quick Menu: select the Active profile, use Add profile... to save the current settings as a new profile, and use Profile management... to edit profiles.
ThemeSystem follows Windows; Light and Dark set the appearance. Takes effect immediately, even without OK.
Note

If you change the settings of a custom profile, they are saved to the profile when you apply. The default profiles remain unchanged – you are asked whether the changes should be saved as a new profile or only applied as current settings.

Tip

Switch pages with the keyboard: Ctrl+Tab or Ctrl+Shift+Tab (or Ctrl+Page Down / Page Up); in the sidebar also with the arrow keys. Enter corresponds to OK. With the minimize icon you put the window into the taskbar.

app-tab.Title: “Application” page
app-tab.Summary: Defines what happens automatically after the scan – only when the Quick Menu is turned off.
app-tab.Html:
“Application” page
ApplicationScan to Folder, Scan to E-Mail, Scan to Print, Scan to Word, Scan to Excel, Scan to PowerPoint, Scan Picture Folder, Edit with PDF – and below them your own programs.
E-mail options...Appears for Scan to E-Mail and opens the e-mail options.
Print options...Appears for Scan to Print and opens the print options.
Install/Uninstall...Add or remove your own programs (more).
Note

If the Quick Menu is turned on, this page is grayed out – you then choose the destination after the scan.

Tip

With the Quick Menu, you open the email and print settings via the gear icon on the tiles Send by email and Print. Values changed there take effect immediately and are also saved to the active custom profile (default profiles remain unchanged).

A custom application is started after the scan with its arguments; the saved files are appended as further arguments.

save-tab.Title: “Save” page
save-tab.Summary: Where the scans are saved and what the files are called.
save-tab.Html:
“Save” page
Save folder for image dataThe target folder. Change it with Browse... (the field itself is not editable). The icon next to it opens the folder in Explorer; a right-click copies the path. Default setting: Documents\SpeedScanManager.
File name format...Opens the File name format window. Next to it you see an example of the next file name.
Rename file after scanOn: after the scan, the Save to folder window appears, in which you can still change name and folder.
Note

For Scan to Folder and “Save to folder” in the Quick Menu, this window always appears, regardless of the switch.

Tip

Existing files are never overwritten: with the same name, _1, _2 etc. is appended. If several files are created (e.g. one image per page), they get consecutive numbers.

scanmode-tab.Title: “Scan mode” page
scanmode-tab.Summary: Resolution, color, and whether scanning is one- or two-sided.
scanmode-tab.Html:
“Scan mode” page

Image quality

The higher the resolution, the sharper the image – but the scan takes longer and the file becomes larger.

Image qualityColor / GrayBlack and white
Automatic200 dpi400 dpi
Normal150 dpi300 dpi
Fine200 dpi400 dpi
Best300 dpi600 dpi
Outstanding600 dpi1200 dpi

If the scanner cannot do a resolution, the program uses the nearest one and points this out with a balloon tip.

Color mode

Automatic color detectionScans in color and saves each page as color, gray or black and white, as appropriate.
ColorAlways in color (default setting).
GrayAlways in grayscale.
Black and whiteAlways black and white – ideal for text, very small files.
Warning

With automatic color detection, pages with little color may be detected as gray or black and white.

Scan side

AutomaticDefault setting: if paper is in the feeder, scanning is two-sided and blank back pages are removed – otherwise the flatbed is used, if available.
Duplex scan (two-sided)Front and back.
Simplex scan (one-sided)Front side only.
Flatbed scanningVia the glass surface. The paper size is set to A4 (no automatic detection).

If the scanner cannot do duplex or has no flatbed, the program scans one-sided or via the feeder and reports this with a balloon tip.

More settings

Continue scanning after the current scanAsks “Scan more documents?” after each pass (more).
Options...Brightness, blank pages, skew, rotation, order – in the Scan mode options window.
Tip

The page can also be opened via the Custom tile on the General page.

filetype-tab.Title: “File type” page
filetype-tab.Summary: File format (PDF, JPEG, PNG) and text recognition for searchable PDFs.
filetype-tab.Html:
“File type” page

File format

PDF (*.pdf)All pages in one PDF file – or split according to the PDF options (Options... button).
JPEG (*.jpg)One image file per page. Not available in color mode “Black and white”.
PNG (*.png)One lossless image file per page.

How to create a searchable PDF

  1. Select PDF as the file format.
  2. Turn on Convert to searchable PDF.
  3. Under Language, select the language of the document (or Automatic detection), under Quality choose Accurate or Fast, and under Target pages choose First page or All pages.
  4. Click OK. The recognized text then lies invisibly over the image – you can search in it and copy text.

Highlighted text as keyword

If Add highlighted text as keyword of the PDF file is on, passages marked with a highlighter are entered as keywords in the PDF properties. Under Target highlight you choose the first or all highlighted passages. This only works together with text recognition – otherwise it is skipped and a balloon tip appears.

Languages

The list contains all text recognition languages: German, English, Japanese, French, Spanish, Chinese simplified/traditional, Portuguese, Russian, Korean, Italian, Polish, Dutch, Turkish and Arabic. Installed are the language chosen in the setup and English; the others are marked not installed.

  1. Select a language marked not installed.
  2. Confirm the question Download now? with Yes (about 5–20 MB, depending on the language).
  3. A window shows the progress; click Cancel to abort. Afterwards the language is selected.

If you change the program language (on the General page), SpeedScan Manager also offers to download the text recognition for that language. Downloaded languages are stored in %LocalAppData%\SpeedScanManager\tessdata.

With Automatic detection, the program selects an installed language for each page based on the script; otherwise German and English are used.

Quality

AccurateDefault. Recognizes most reliably, even with small or faint text.
FastAbout twice as fast, and almost as good with clean print. For Italian, Dutch, Turkish and Arabic, Accurate is always used.
Note

If a saved language is not installed, a balloon tip appears when scanning and the available languages (preferably German/English) are used.

paper-tab.Title: “Paper” page
paper-tab.Summary: Paper size, carrier sheet and detection of sheets fed in double.
paper-tab.Html:
“Paper” page

Paper size

Automatic detection (default setting) crops each page to the sheet: the gray scanner background and empty areas after the end of the sheet are removed. It is also required for long pages. Also selectable:

SizeDimensions
A3 / A4 / A5 / A6297 × 420 / 210 × 297 / 148 × 210 / 105 × 148 mm
B4 / B5 / B6 (JIS)257 × 364 / 182 × 257 / 128 × 182 mm
Postcard100 × 148 mm
Business card55 × 91 mm
Letter / Legal8.5 × 11 in. / 8.5 × 14 in.
Double Letter11 × 17 in.
Custom sizesup to 10, via Custom...
Note

Which sizes work depends on the scanner – otherwise a balloon tip appears. For the flatbed there is no automatic detection.

Carrier sheet settings...Opens the carrier sheet settings.
Custom...Create custom paper sizes (more).

Multifeed detection

Detects when the scanner feeds two sheets at the same time.

OffNo check (default setting).
Overlap check [ultrasonic]Measures the sheet thickness.
Length checkCompares the sheet length.
Overlap and length checkBoth. If the scanner cannot do this at the same time, only ultrasonic is used.
Note

If the scanner reports its capabilities, unsupported entries are marked “(not supported)” and cannot be selected.

filesize-tab.Title: “File size” page
filesize-tab.Summary: How strongly color and gray images are compressed – smaller files or better quality.
filesize-tab.Html:
“File size” page

The slider has five levels (default setting 3). It determines the JPEG quality – also in PDF files, Office documents and the picture folder.

LevelJPEG qualityResult
1100best quality, largest file
285
370balanced
450
530smallest file, visible losses
Note

With color mode “Black and white” and with the PNG format, the slider is grayed out: black-and-white images and PNG files are saved losslessly.

Tip

For small files to send, the Small file tile on the General page is usually enough.

dialogs.Title: Windows and dialogs
dialogs.Summary: Quick Menu, the Save window and all other dialogs, with pictures.

postscan-media.Title: Quick Menu
postscan-media.Summary: “Where would you like to scan to?” – appears after each scan when the Quick Menu is turned on.
postscan-media.Html:
The Quick Menu
1Click a destination to select it (or use the arrow keys). A double-click starts it immediately.
2Cancel or close icon: closes the window. The file remains saved (balloon tip “Scan saved”).
3Save: carries out the selected destination.

At the top it shows how many pages were scanned. The file is already in the save folder at this point. The window stays in the foreground.

The eight destinations

Save to folderOpens Save to folder for title and target folder.
Send by emailEmail program with the file as an attachment. The gear icon at the top right opens the email options.
PrintPrints the pages. The gear icon at the top right opens the print options.
To WordWord document (.docx) with the pages as images.
To ExcelExcel file (.xlsx) with the pages as images.
To PowerPointPresentation (.pptx) with the pages as images.
To picture folderJPEG files in Pictures\SpeedScanManager.
Edit with PDF EditOpens the file in the program set up for it.

postscan-save.Title: Save to folder
postscan-save.Summary: Check the pages and set the file name and target folder.
postscan-save.Html:
The “Save to folder” window
1Preview of the scanned page.
2Browse through the pages (“Page 2 of 3”).
3Set title: the suggested file name – change it as you like. Invalid characters are replaced.
4Set target folder: choose a folder with Browse... (the field is not directly editable).
5Save: applies name and folder.

At the bottom right, the group Scan settings summarizes how the scan was made (preset, resolution, color mode, scan side, file format, compression).

Note

The file is already saved – the window only renames or moves it. With several files, a number is appended; existing files are never overwritten (_1 etc.).

Warning

Cancel, Esc or the close icon ask “Discard scan?”. With Yes the created files are deleted; with No you return to the window.

scanmode-options.Title: Scan mode options
scanmode-options.Summary: Brightness and automatic image enhancements. Open via Options... on the “Scan mode” page.
scanmode-options.Html:
The “Scan mode options” window

Brightness

Seven levels from “Darker -3” to “Lighter +3” (middle = normal). The slider only applies to color mode Black and white – otherwise it is grayed out (“Only for black-and-white scans”).

Image processing

Setting for text documents onlyIncreases the contrast for black and white – good for text and handwriting.
Allow automatic removal of blank pagesRemoves blank pages (default setting: on). If all pages are blank, no file is saved.
Correct skew automaticallyStraightens pages that were fed in crooked (default setting: off).
Allow automatic image rotationRotates pages scanned sideways or upside down the right way round (default setting: on). For this, a piece of text is read on a trial basis. If there is too little text, no rotation takes place.
Documents are loaded face upOn if you load the stack with the text facing up: the order is reversed so that the pages are sorted correctly.
Note

With scan side “Automatic”, blank back pages are also removed even without the “blank pages” option.

OK applies, Cancel discards the changes.

pdf-options.Title: PDF options
pdf-options.Summary: Split the PDF and protect it with a password. Open via Options... on the “File type” page (only for PDF).
pdf-options.Html:
The “PDF options” window

Split PDF pages

Multi-page PDF fileAll pages in one PDF file (default setting).
Number of pages after which a new PDF file is createdAfter every such number of pages (1–999) a new file begins, e.g. Name_001.pdf, Name_002.pdf.

Password

  1. Turn on Set password for PDF file.
  2. Enter the password under Password and repeat it under Confirm.
  3. Click OK. If the password is missing or both entries do not match, a message appears and the window stays open.
Note

The password is stored encrypted and can only be read by your Windows user account. If it cannot be read (e.g. settings from another PC), the protection stays on and the program asks for the password before the next scan – then enter the password again here.

filename-format.Title: File name format
filename-format.Summary: How the scanned files are named automatically. Open via File name format... on the “Save” page.
filename-format.Html:
The “File name format” window with a custom name

At the bottom of the window, Example shows what the next file name looks like.

Your operating system settingDate and time in the Windows format. Disallowed characters such as : and / are changed to -, e.g. 12.04.2026 15-30-45.pdf.
JJJJMMTThhmmssDate and time in one piece, e.g. 20260412153045.pdf (default setting).
Custom file nameYour own name plus a consecutive number, e.g. Invoice_001.pdf.

Set your own name

  1. Select Custom file name.
  2. Enter the beginning of the name under File name (up to 30 characters).
  3. Under Counter, select how many digits the number has (3, 4 or 5).
  4. Click OK.
Note

Not allowed are the characters \ / : * ? " < > |, a period at the end, and reserved Windows names (e.g. CON, NUL, COM1). The counter starts at 1 and continues after the highest number already in the folder. If a name already exists, _1, _2 etc. is appended.

Apply (bottom left) applies without closing; Cancel discards the changes.

new-profile.Title: Add new profile
new-profile.Summary: A small window for the name of a new profile.
new-profile.Html:
Enter a name for a new profile

Enter a name (up to 64 characters) and click OK. The name must be unique – upper and lower case are not distinguished. An invalid or duplicate name is rejected with a message.

Via “Add profile...”General page of the settings: the new profile takes over the currently set values.
Via “Add...” in profile managementThe new profile starts with the default settings.
Note

The same window also appears when renaming (“Rename profile”). In total, up to 20 profiles are possible (including the default profiles).

profile-mgmt-dialog.Title: Profile management
profile-mgmt-dialog.Summary: Add, rename, delete and sort profiles.
profile-mgmt-dialog.Html:
The “Profile management” window
Add...New profile with the default settings (up to 20 profiles).
Rename...Give the selected profile a new name.
DeleteDeletes the selected profile after a confirmation prompt.
Move up / Move downMoves the profile in the list.
CloseCloses the window.
Note

The eight default profiles cannot be renamed or deleted, but they can be moved. Custom profiles can be edited freely.

app-manage.Title: Custom applications
app-manage.Summary: Add up to ten custom programs that are started with the files after the scan.
app-manage.Html:
The “Install/Uninstall” window

Add a program

  1. Click Add....
  2. Use Browse... to select the program file (*.exe). If the name is still empty, the file name is taken over.
  3. Adjust the Name (unique, up to 64 characters) – this is how the program appears in the “Application” list.
  4. If needed, enter Arguments. The scanned files are then appended in quotation marks.
  5. Click OK.
Add or edit a program
Edit...Change the details of the selected program. A double-click on the entry does the same.
RemoveRemoves the selected program from the list.
CloseCloses the window.
Note

Changes to this list are saved immediately – regardless of OK or Cancel in the settings window. If a program cannot be found or does not start later, a message appears; the scan remains saved.

email-options.Title: Email options
email-options.Summary: Recipient and subject for Scan to E-Mail. Open via the “Application” page or the gear icon on the Send by email tile in the Quick Menu.
email-options.Html:
The “Scan to E-Mail” window
Default recipientEntered in every new email.
Subject templateSubject of the email. If the field is left empty, it reads “Scanned document”.
Note

The email program that is set in Windows as the MAPI default is used. If it cannot be opened, a message appears and the folder with the file is opened – so you can attach it by hand.

print-options.Title: Print options
print-options.Summary: The printer for Scan to Print. Open via the “Application” page or the gear icon on the Print tile in the Quick Menu.
print-options.Html:
The “Scan to Print” window

Under Target printer, select one of the installed printers. (Default printer) always uses the current Windows default printer.

Note

Printing is done at original size; landscape is selected automatically if needed. If the set printer no longer exists, you are asked whether to print on the default printer. If no printer is installed at all, the scan is only saved.

carrier-sheet-dialog.Title: Carrier sheet settings
carrier-sheet-dialog.Summary: Turn on carrier sheet mode and choose the size of the finished image.
carrier-sheet-dialog.Html:
The “Carrier sheet settings” window with instructions
Enable carrier sheet modeTurns on the joining. If the switch is off, the other fields are locked.
ModeCreate two pages in one image: front and back (duplex) are placed side by side.
Output image sizeAutomatic detection, A3–A6, B4–B6 (JIS), Letter, Double Letter, Postcard, Business card, carrier sheet size (220 × 297 mm) or Custom...
Custom sizeAppears with “Custom...”: width and height in mm (50–2000).

The Instructions group shows in three pictures how it is done: fold the document, place it in the carrier sheet, feed it into the scanner.

Warning

Only certain scanner models support the carrier sheet.

custom-size-dialog.Title: Custom paper sizes
custom-size-dialog.Summary: Create up to ten custom paper sizes – they then appear in the “Paper size” list.
custom-size-dialog.Html:
The “Custom sizes” window
  1. Click Add....
  2. Enter a Name (up to 62 characters) and the Width and Length in millimeters (1–9999).
  3. Click OK.
Edit...Change the name or dimensions of the selected size.
RemoveDelete the selected size.
Selected sizeShows width × length of the selected size.
CloseCloses the window.

version-info.Title: Version information
version-info.Summary: Version, license and links to the project. Open via Help › Version information in the tray menu.
version-info.Html:
The “Version information” window

License and creditsNotes on the GPL-3.0 license and the libraries used: NTwain (TWAIN), Tesseract.NET (text recognition) and PdfSharpCore (PDF).
GitHub / DiscordOpen the project page or the Discord server in the browser.

OKCloses the window.

driver-info.Title: Scanner and driver info
driver-info.Summary: Technical details about the scanner and the program files – useful when you ask for help.
driver-info.Html:
The “Scanner and driver information” window
ScannerName, manufacturer, product family and driver version. The values can be selected and copied. Without a scanner, “No scanner connected” is shown there.
File versionName, version and date of the program file and of the libraries NTwain, Tesseract, PdfSharpCore and DocumentFormat.OpenXml.
OKCloses the window.

profiles.Title: Profiles
profiles.Summary: Save and select fixed settings for recurring tasks.

profile-mgmt.Title: Working with profiles
profile-mgmt.Summary: A profile saves all scan settings – e.g. “Invoices” as PDF into a fixed folder.
profile-mgmt.Html:
Profiles only apply when the Quick Menu is off. A profile includes the pages Application, Save, Scan mode, File type, Paper and File size. Up to 20 profiles are possible, including the eight default profiles.

Create a new profile

  1. Open the Settings and set everything the way the profile should work.
  2. On the General page, in the Profile group, click Add profile....
  3. Enter a name and click OK.

Use a profile

Select the profile under Active profile and click OK. From now on, every press of the button scans with this profile.

Change a profile

Select the profile, change the settings and click OK or Apply – the changes end up in the profile. Default profiles remain unchanged; you are asked whether a new profile should be created.

Rename, delete, sort

In the profile management – opened with Profile management... on the General page or in the tray menu.

Note

If the Quick Menu is turned on, the “Profile” group is grayed out.

troubleshooting.Title: Solving problems
troubleshooting.Summary: Common problems, multifeed and all messages of the program.

faq.Title: Common problems
faq.Summary: The most common questions – with the quickest solution.
faq.Html:
The scanner is not detected

  • Is the scanner turned on and connected via USB or network?
  • Is the manufacturer's TWAIN driver installed (32-bit TWAIN source)?
  • Are several scanners connected? Choose the right one under Select scanner.
  • Wait a few seconds after starting the program – only then is the scanner queried. If necessary, unplug the USB cable briefly and plug it in again.

The button on the scanner does not start a scan

Select Set up scan button... in the tray menu and confirm the Windows prompt with Yes. If a scan is running or a window is still open afterwards (e.g. the Quick Menu), the button is ignored. More about the scan button

Where is my scanned file?

Select Show scan result in the tray menu. By default, scans are stored in Documents\SpeedScanManager; you change the folder on the Save page.

No file was saved

All pages were detected as blank and removed – for example when only blank back pages were captured during a one-sided scan. You will find the option for this in the Scan mode options.

The “Application” page is grayed out

The Quick Menu is turned on – you then choose the destination after each scan. If you want a fixed destination, turn off Use Quick Menu on the General page.

JPEG cannot be selected

With color mode Black and white, JPEG is not available. Choose PDF or PNG – or another color mode.

The files are too large

On the General page, select the Small file tile, or increase the level on the File size page. For pure text, Black and white saves the most.

Pages are skewed, upside down or sorted incorrectly

In the Scan mode options: Correct skew automatically, Allow automatic image rotation and – if you load documents with the text facing up – Documents are loaded face up.

Text recognition does not know my language

Select the language on the File type page under Language and confirm the download (more). An internet connection is required for this.

The scanner reports “Multifeed”

Read What to do with a multifeed?

Tip

A list of all messages with explanations can be found under List of messages.

multifeed-dialog.Title: Multifeed detected
multifeed-dialog.Summary: The scanner has probably fed two sheets at once. It waits until you decide.
multifeed-dialog.Html:
The “Multifeed detected!” window

You see the previous page and the affected page (marked in red). If there is no previous page, “No preview available” is shown there.

RetryDiscards the pages of this pass and cancels the scan (“Scan discarded”). Load the pages again and scan again. Default button (Enter); the close icon has the same effect.
Accept this pageKeeps the page and continues scanning.
Turn off detectionAccepts the page and ignores further messages for the rest of this scan.
Warning

Envelopes or sheets with stuck-on notes, photos or stamps are often wrongly detected as multifeed. Esc does not close this window.

multifeed-measures.Title: What to do with a multifeed?
multifeed-measures.Summary: How to decide correctly when the window “Multifeed detected!” appears.
multifeed-measures.Html:
The pages are complete and in the right order

Click Accept this page – the scan continues. The same applies to envelopes or sheets with sticky notes, photos or stamps; if more such pages follow, select Turn off detection.

A page is missing or the order is wrong

  1. Click Retry. The pages of this pass are discarded.
  2. Remove all sheets from the scanner – including from the output tray – and align the stack flush.
  3. Load the whole stack again and start a new scan.
Tip

If this happens often, fan out the stack briefly before loading. You set which detection is used on the Paper page.

PDFPortable Document Format
